## What does self-storage in Kolkata with StowNest include? Insurance up to ₹2.5 lakhs, 24/7 CCTV, pest control and photo updates.


StowNest offers **[self storage in Kolkata](https://stownest.com/self-storage-kolkata?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=self-storage-kolkata)** with ₹2.5 lakhs insurance cover against theft, fire and natural calamities. Our warehouse is monitored by CCTV cameras 24/7 and pest control is done every 7 to 10 days. Every item is tracked using a barcode. Customers can view pictures and videos of their stuff using the StowNest website. If any item suffers physical damage during transportation or storage, StowNest repairs or replaces it.


## **Before you hand over your stuff**


It takes a good deal of trust to let someone else take charge of your things. If you live in Kolkata, you probably already know why. Homes here hold things that are dear to the family: a teak almirah that has been there since grandfather’s time, a saree trunk, the brass utensils used during Pujas, old books, photo albums.


It’s a good idea to know what you are getting before you book storage space. This post details what StowNest storage in Kolkata has to offer. Insurance Cover of ₹2.5 Lakhs is something customers enquire about first, and understandably so.


Stored items with[StowNest](https://stownest.com/self-storage-kolkata?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=self-storage-kolkata) are insured up to ₹2.5 lakhs against theft, fire and natural calamities. Protection against natural calamities is a good thing to have considering Kolkata is no stranger to floods.


It's also important to understand this in the context of real-world situations. The cover is for your items in storage, and the limit is 2.5 lakh rupees. If you have some valuable items or if you would just like to understand how a claim works, contact the support team before you make your reservation. They will explain it to you.


## **24/7 CCTV Monitoring**


The warehouse is under 24/7 surveillance by CCTV.


Storage is only as secure as the safety measures behind it. Your items are stored in a monitored space, not in a locked room that is not checked upon. For people who are concerned with the storage space that their relatives or godown (warehouse) rents, this makes a real difference.


## **Pest Control Every 7 to 10 Days**


This is a feature that is rarely focused on but is very valuable in Kolkata.


Furniture, books and paper are prone to pests, especially if they are left for a long time without being used or touched. In Kolkata, the humid climate and monsoons makes things even worse. Termites and silverfish love paper, books and old wood. You don't notice these pests and what they are doing to your items until it is too late.


At the **[StowNest warehouse](https://www.google.com/imgres?q=stownest%20warehouse%20kolkata&imgurl=https%3A%2F%2Fstownest.com%2Fimg%2Fcontent%2Fbgs%2FV2%2Fpackers4.webp&imgrefurl=https%3A%2F%2Fstownest.com%2F&docid=pV1NpNbWBzQ4GM&tbnid=nWlIYxSZXfidaM&vet=12ahUKEwjN3pfR3dyXAxULjeEIHVW6DFgQnPAOegQIIBAA..i&w=1200&h=800&hcb=2&ved=2ahUKEwjN3pfR3dyXAxULjeEIHVW6DFgQnPAOegQIIBAA)** , pest control is done every 7 to 10 days. This means that pests are controlled before they start bothering.


## **Barcode Tracking for Every Item**


All items stored are barcode tracked. This means stored items are tracked and logged clearly, unlike a list or a pile with no label.


This may not seem very important, but it really helps when you need to get a specific item back. Barcode tracking means we know the exact location of an item among thousands. This is much better than the old system of someone searching through a godown and hoping to get the item you need.


## **Responsibility if Something Gets Damaged**


Although we take every precaution while handling your items, things can go wrong. What is important is what happens after that.


If an item gets physically damaged during storage or transportation, StowNest is liable to repair or replace the item. You will not have to take time off work to argue or investigate what happened. We take full responsibility for this.


## **How Pickup, Delivery, and Warehouse Visits Work**


You don’t have to find your own transport. You call customer care, roughly describe what you want to store, and we pick up your items from your home. When you wish to have your items back, you ask for delivery.


If you want to do the pickup/drop yourself, you can visit the warehouse for pickup/drop of your items. Just notify customer support in advance for the visit, because this is not a walk-in center.


## **How Pricing Works**


We price by the items you store, not by a fixed unit size like a box or a room. So, if you are storing a few boxes and a furniture piece, you are not paying for a full room. For a quote, contact our customer support with your list of items and an estimate of how long you wish to store them.


## **What People in Kolkata Usually Store**


The items stored usually reflect what a typical household in Kolkata stores. Most of the stored items are furniture like almirahs, beds, sofas, dining room tables, bookshelves, etc. Items for Puja and Festival Decorations are stored off season along with extra bedding and winter clothes. Stored heirlooms and sentimental items are also stored along with boxes of books, records and household items. If you are not sure of an item, ask us when you call.


## **Who Finds This Most Useful**


Families moving out of large homes, people moving between homes, families going through renovations or repainting, and those who just need some extra space can all find this service useful.


## **A Clear List Beats a Vague Promise**


Most storage facilities say “safe” and “secure” and leave it at that. We prefer to be more specific. We have insurance of up to ₹2.5 lakhs. We also have 24/7 CCTV. Pest control is done every 7 to 10 days. There are picture and video updates. Each item is tracked via barcodes. We are also responsible for any damages that happen in our care. If you’re looking for a storage solution in Kolkata, these are the questions you should be asking, and the answers you should be getting.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. What does self storage in Kolkata with StowNest include?**


**[StowNest](https://stownest.com/self-storage-kolkata?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=self-storage-kolkata)** provides insurance up to ₹2.5 lakhs against theft, fire and natural calamities; 24/7 CCTV surveillance; pest control every 7 to 10 days; barcode tracking; and photographic and video updates .


**2. Will my furniture be insured in a storage facility in Kolkata?**


Yes, StowNest provides insurance up to ₹2.5 lakhs against theft, fire and natural calamities for all stored items. For information on how claims work, contact customer support before you book.


**3. How will storage units in Kolkata protect my belongings from pests and humidity?**


StowNest's warehouse has pest control every 7 to 10 days. This helps protect fabric, books and paper from pests which thrive in humid conditions.


**4. Is CCTV camera surveillance available at your storage facility in Kolkata?**


Yes, our warehouse in Kolkata is monitored by CCTV 24/7.


**5. What happens if my item gets damaged during storage or transportation in Kolkata?**


If your item gets damaged during the time we store or transport your items, then we will replace or repair the item.


**6. How does StowNest charge for safe storage in Kolkata?**


We charge you for the items you store, not the space you occupy. For a quote, let us know roughly what you’ll be storing and for how long, and a representative will contact you.


**7. What can I store with StowNest in Kolkata?**


Typically, customers store furnishings, Puja and festival items, bedding, books, heirlooms, and household items. You can contact us to check if you are storing something else.
